# Catalogue packs

Every pack generator takes `seed`, an optional `preset`, `params` and `style` like the core generators. Characters and creatures share `role` (`hero`, `enemy`, `boss`), `size`, `variant` (0-7 on-model variety) and `detail`. `queryAsset({ operation: 'listGenerators', generator: '<id>' })` returns every param and its range.
